# Fin Growth India (FGI)

> Fin Growth India is a business-support and professional-growth organization based in Mansarovar, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Established May 2026, it connects people — students, homemakers, freshers, job seekers, freelancers, and working professionals aged 18 or older — with business-support opportunities, skill development, and practical guidance across areas such as banking support, KYC-related operations, broking support, credit card support, customer support, and data entry and management.

> Submitting an inquiry does not guarantee selection, work allocation, or earnings. Compensation varies by role and project; applicable terms are explained before any work begins.
